_note: SYNTHETIC template seed set (8). Structural 80% only; the practitioner adds the relational 20% in Gmail before sending (PRD 6.6). Placeholders: {{assessment_id}} {{family_ref}} {{issue_title}} {{due_date}} {{recipient_name}} {{my_name}}

rows.name: Chase referee (reference outstanding)
rows.body_template:
Dear {{recipient_name}},

I am writing regarding the reference I requested in connection with a fostering assessment. My records show it is still outstanding, and I would be grateful to receive it by {{due_date}} so the assessment can progress.

If it would help to complete it by phone instead, do let me know a convenient time.

With thanks,
{{my_name}}

rows.name: Availability request (visit scheduling)
rows.subject_template: [{{assessment_id}}] Availability for the next assessment visit
rows.body_template:
Dear {{recipient_name}},

We are ready to arrange the next assessment visit. Please could you let me know two or three dates and times that would suit you over the coming fortnight?

I will confirm as soon as I hear back.

Kind regards,
{{my_name}}

rows.name: Document request (missing evidence)
rows.body_template:
Dear {{recipient_name}},

To complete this part of the assessment I still need the following: {{issue_title}}. Please could you send it across by {{due_date}}?

If anything about the request is unclear, I am happy to talk it through.

Kind regards,
{{my_name}}

rows.name: Progress update to commissioning agency
rows.body_template:
Dear {{recipient_name}},

A brief update on assessment {{assessment_id}} ({{family_ref}}). Current position:

• [summary point]
• [next step and expected timing]

I will send the next update at the next milestone, or sooner if anything material changes.

Kind regards,
{{my_name}}

rows.name: Information to applicant
rows.body_template:
Dear {{recipient_name}},

I wanted to pass on the following in connection with your assessment:

[information]

Please do get in touch if you have any questions.

Kind regards,
{{my_name}}

rows.name: Decision needed — panel date
rows.body_template:
Dear {{recipient_name}},

We are at the point of fixing a panel date for {{assessment_id}} ({{family_ref}}). To move forward I need a decision on the following:

• Option A: [date]
• Option B: [date]

Could you confirm your preference by {{due_date}}? Once decided I will make the arrangements.

Kind regards,
{{my_name}}

rows.name: Confirmation of discussion (file note by email)
rows.subject_template: [{{assessment_id}}] For the record — summary of our discussion
rows.body_template:
Dear {{recipient_name}},

For the record, this note confirms my understanding of what we discussed today:

• [point discussed]
• [any action agreed, and by whom]

Please let me know by {{due_date}} if anything here does not match your recollection; otherwise I will take this as an accurate record.

Kind regards,
{{my_name}}

rows.name: Confirmation of consent received
rows.body_template:
Dear {{recipient_name}},

Thank you — this confirms for the record that I have received your consent in relation to {{issue_title}}. I have noted it on file for assessment {{assessment_id}}.

Kind regards,
{{my_name}}
